verdict.rationale: Svelte provides llms.txt documentation and an official MCP server that lets AI agents access Svelte docs and get static analysis feedback on generated code, which supports AI-native workflows, but this is documentation-assistance for agents rather than a natural-language command interface for operating Svelte itself (no CLI chat mode, no NL-driven scaffolding beyond MCP doc lookup). Missing for 10: evidence of an actual NL command interface to build/run/modify Svelte projects, independent confirmation of the MCP server's real-world use, and any first-party chat/agent-driven CLI beyond `sv` commands.
